extraction_warnings: Task audit hint stated 'Main Notes (3 notes)' for Chapter 20, but the source PDF contains 6 Main Notes (numbered 1 through 6) plus 3 Sub-Heading Notes. All 6 chapter notes and 3 sub-heading notes have been extracted verbatim. The audit count appears incorrect.

Tariff codes in the source PDF use no-dot 8-digit format (NNNNNNNN, e.g., '20011000'). All codes normalized to NNNN.NN.NN format (e.g., '2001.10.00') per project schema. 6-digit subheading codes (e.g., '200390') normalized to NNNN.NN (e.g., '2003.90').
Section IV Main Note about 'pellets' appears on PDF page 1 above the Chapter 20 title and is attributed to section_notes (Section IV), not chapter_notes.

Note 1 of Chapter 20 is the primary exclusion note with sub-clauses (a) through (e). Each sub-clause has been extracted as a separate entry in exclusion_clauses while the full note text is preserved verbatim in chapter_notes.
Heading 2008 description in the PDF ends with the word 'other' concatenated onto the heading description ('not elsewhere specified or included.other'). Preserved verbatim as it appears in source.
Heading 2003 description in the PDF reads 'Mushrooms and truffles, prepared or preserved otherwise than by vinegar or acetic acid.' — verbatim including trailing period.

Heading 2006 in the source PDF has the description 'Vegetables, fruit, nuts, fruit-peel and other parts of plants, preserved by sugar (drained, glac or crystallised).' — the word 'glac' appears to be an OCR artifact for 'glacé'; preserved verbatim as in source PDF.

Several tariff line descriptions use 'sub-heading' prefix labels (e.g., 'Beans (Vigna spp., Phaseolus spp.) : --Beans, shelled', 'Other vegetables and mixtures of vegetables : -- Bamboo shoots'). These are preserved verbatim from the source PDF and follow the ITC(HS) convention of repeating the parent subheading text before the dash-prefixed tariff-line text.

Heading 2008 sub-heading 2008.11 (Ground-nuts) carries a Policy Condition with Notification No '28(RE-2012)/2009-2014' dated '03.01.2013' specifying APEDA registration and Aflatoxin certification requirements (sub-clauses (a) and (b)). This is captured verbatim in the policy_conditions array.

Heading 2009 description rendered in PDF in ALL CAPS ('FRUIT OR NUT JUICES (INCLUDING GRAPE MUST AND COCONUT WATER) AND VEGETABLE JUICES...'). Normalized to Title Case form following ITC(HS) standard while preserving content verbatim. The original casing is preserved in extraction_warnings record.

Tariff line code '2006.00.00' represents heading 2006 which is a 'one-line heading' — the heading itself has only a single 8-digit tariff line with the same descriptive text. Captured as subheading 2006.00 with one tariff line 2006.00.00.

Tariff line code '2009.50.00' (Tomato juice) sits under heading 2009 directly — there is no '20095X' family of subheadings in the source PDF; this single tariff line forms its own subheading bucket 2009.50.

PDF table-chrome headers ('Sl.No. Notes Notification Date Notification No', 'Itc(hs) Code. Description Export Policy Policy Condition', 'Main Notes', 'Sub-Heading Notes', 'Product Description and Export Policy') were recognized as table headers and EXCLUDED from the legal notes per extraction rules.

Sub-heading note 3 spans two PDF rows (continues from page 2 to page 3 with the Brix value definition). Reassembled into a single verbatim note covering sub-headings 2009 12, 2009 21, 2009 31, 2009 41, 2009 61 and 2009 71.

chapter_notes.text: This Chapter does not cover : (a) vegetables, fruit or nuts, prepared or preserved by the processes specified in Chapter 7, 8 or 11; (b) vegetable fats and oils (Chapter 15); (c) food preparations containing more than 20% by weight of sausage, meat, meat offal, blood, insect, fish or crustaceans, molluscs or other aquatic invertebrates, or any combination thereof (Chapter 16); (d) bakers wares and other products of heading 1905; or (e) homogenised composite food preparations of heading 2104.
Headings 2007 and 2008 do not apply to fruit jellies, fruit pastes, sugar-coated almonds or the like in the form of sugar confectionery (heading 1704) or chocolate confectionery (heading 1806).

Headings 2001, 2004 and 2005 cover, as the case may be, only those products of Chapter 7 or of heading 1105 or 1106 (other than flour, meal and powder of the products of Chapter 8) which have been prepared or preserved by processes other than those referred to in Note 1(a).
Tomato juice, the dry weight content of which is 7% or more is to be classified in heading 2002.

For the purposes of heading 2007, the expression "obtained by cooking" means obtained by heat treatment at atmospheric pressure or under reduced pressure to increase the viscosity of a product through reduction of water content or other means.

For the purposes of heading 2009, the expression "juices, unfermented and not containing added spirit" means juices of an alcoholic strength by volume (see Note 2 to Chapter 22) not exceeding 0.5% volume.

section_notes.text: In this Section, the term "pellets" means products which have been agglomerated either directly by compression or by the addition of a binder in a proportion not exceeding 3 (percent) by weight.

chapter_subheading_notes.text: For the purposes of sub-heading 2005 10, the expression "homogenised vegetables" means preparations of vegetables, finely homogenised, put up for retail sale as food suitable for infants or young children or for dietetic purposes, in containers of a net weight content not exceeding 250 g. For the application of this definition no account isto be taken of small quantities of any ingredients which may have been added to the preparation for seasoning, preservation or other purposes. These preparations may contain a small quantity of visible pieces of vegetables. Subheading 2005 10 takes precedence over all other sub-headings of heading 2005.

For the purposes of sub-heading 2007 10, the expression "homogenised preparations" means preparations of fruit,finely homogenised, put up for retailsale asfood suitable for infants or young children or for dietetic purposes, in containers of a net weight content not exceeding 250 g. For the application of this definition no account is to be taken ofsmall quantities of any ingredients which may have been added to the preparation for seasoning, preservation or other purposes. These preparations may contain a small quantity of visible pieces of fruit. Sub-heading 2007 10 takes precedence over all other Sub-headings of heading 2007.

For the purposes of sub-headings 2009 12, 2009 21, 2009 31, 2009 41, 2009 61 and 2009 71, the expression "Brix value" means the direct reading of degrees Brix obtained from a Brix hydrometer or of refractive index expressed in terms of percentage sucrose content obtained from a refractometer, at a temperature of 20C or corrected for 20C if the reading is made at a different temperature.
